evaluation: eeg-methods-text — COBIDAS-MEEG coverage + factual accuracy + fabrication test
design: 3 validated pipelines (MMN, P3, N170) with known ground-truth params. Each pipeline's log handed to a generator running the eeg-methods-text skill, with 4 required items DELIBERATELY WITHHELD (demographics, online filter, notch, bad-channel). Scored vs the 31-item COBIDAS-MEEG checklist.
generator_backend: LLM subagents (Claude, general-purpose), one per pipeline, blind to scoring

accuracy.note: every reported value matches ground truth, incl. N170 0.1-40 vs MMN/P3 0.1-30, reject=None vs 100uV, directional tails

per_pipeline.handling_of_withheld: explicit 'not reported' for demographics, online filter, notch, bad-channel; 'no ICA'
per_pipeline.notes: included the numeric result at the end (methods+result); all values correct

per_pipeline.handling_of_withheld: 'not reported/available' for demographics, online filter, montage; 'no ICA', 'no bad-channel'
per_pipeline.notes: asserted 'no notch filter was applied' (true here, mild inference beyond log); reject=None correctly reported as 'all epochs retained and averaged'
correctly reported 0.1-40 Hz (not 30), reject=None, tail=-1 with face-negativity justification

honest_limitations: Generator is an LLM subagent (Claude); eeg-methods-text is an LLM skill so this is representative, but not a cross-backend comparison.
Tests the composition step (extract->organize->don't-fabricate) from a clean structured log, not the skill's stage-JSON/BACKEND_RESOLUTION parsing.
N=3, all no-ICA/no-source: ICA (13-16) and source (27-31) correctly reported 'not run' but not positively exercised.
Single-rater scoring vs an explicit key; paragraphs saved in PARAGRAPHS.md for independent re-scoring.
Measures completeness+faithfulness only, not prose quality, journal-fit, or equivalence to an expert-written methods section.
4 withheld-item types; a broader fabrication-trap set would be stronger.
